text: The authors note they had to limit their analysis to multiple-choice tasks because precisely evaluating free text is unsettled, and call for similarity metrics for free-response text and reasoning, which would allow studying the role of similarity in oversight setups such as debate and process supervision.
title: Open question: free-text similarity metrics to study debate and process supervision
